The compiled launch paths select `spmvWarp` (function address 0xe780; runtime launch at 0xca5b) or `spmvShort` (0xe8b0; runtime launch at 0xd94b). Their sm_86 bodies handle all rows and complete CSR intervals, with warp lane-striding/reduction for longer rows and scalar short-row work otherwise.
